definitions.cold: Process restart, unresolved catalogue selection. OS/DNS/CDN caches are not cleared.
definitions.repeat: Select a second queue entry for the same catalogue song without restarting; this loads again, rather than resuming.
definitions.queue: Select the next different catalogue entry immediately; no near-end warmup or artificial seek.
definitions.audio: Windows playing event / Android native playing plus media time > 50 ms. No acoustic speaker measurement.
definitions.p95: Nearest-rank empirical p95 of successes; failures reported separately.
